question: Compare the existing repeated-motion prediction with a last-pose warm start across all four previously fixed compensation/sampling controls.
reference_boundary: Exploratory: the complete selected reference, prior scores and all original constraint diagnostics were already inspected. No blind or held-out claim.
candidate_policy: First scan uses ordinary register(points). Every later scan uses relative_prediction=identity, so the warm start is the last returned pose. No external prediction is supplied to the first scan.
baseline_policy: Reuse the four previously frozen repeated-motion estimates, reports and fully replayed diagnostics; do not rerun or overwrite them.
invariants: Require identical first two pose bits/reports, every selected source_sensor point bit and registration-point count, and the full gyro-compensated point digest. Preserve all original scans, points, failure labels and parameters.
compensation: Same held body gyro with zero declared bias, identity IMU-from-LiDAR and max_gap_s=.05; no acceleration translation or rejected initialization state. References remain max original integer point time.
diagnostic_scope: Capture every candidate native snapshot. Independently reconstruct its fixed-match weights, normal matrix, right-hand side, support/radius/spectrum and correction from the declared prediction. Candidate map matching is not independently replayed. Source coordinates must match the prior captured sources bitwise. Insertion consistency undoes the prior canonical world pose then applies the candidate pose, within 2e-8 m; this is not independent revoxelization.
interpretation: Prediction changes future poses, local maps, thresholds, rotation centers and correspondences. This is a closed-loop policy-sensitivity trial, not a fixed-map causal decomposition, calibrated accuracy result or unique physical explanation.
freeze_boundary: Freeze sources/native/dependencies/settings before new measurements. Save all four complete candidate estimates, every stopping label and 740 raw snapshots plus a hash closure before any new scoring.
reference_policy: Reuse exact inherited assumptions: TUM syntax and reference-world-from-LiDAR, fixed zero offset, identity body transform, unit scale, integer nanoseconds, maximum 100 ms bracketing, no extrapolation, proper rigid position fit/rank guard, first-pose diagnostics and original consecutive edges. No GT-driven clock/scale/axis/extrinsic/window/threshold selection.
oracle: Frozen installed evo arithmetic on all eight cohorts, with bit-identical reuse of the prior independently audited paired reference. Tolerances 2e-8 m/matrix and 1e-5 degrees; this does not supply missing body/clock provenance.
failures: Abort on cohort, state, source, first-two, finite-pose or arithmetic mismatch; retain partial rows/poses and raw snapshots at a fresh output path. Never score an incomplete candidate cohort.
reporting: Report every old/new case and all exclusions/failures. No winner adoption, changed estimator default or initialization gate, accepted physical state, GLIM, GPU or runtime claim.
